segments.text: Protagonist of Route A, a youth leaving his innocence behind.

2 years after the disappearance of his twin sister, Hinata leads a dull school life. Depressed and devoid of any goals, his life drastically changes after receiving a mysterious text message from his supposedly dead sister.

Hinata's childhood friend and classmate, who pesters him to no end, much to Hinata's dismay. She offers her help when Hinata starts searching for Mutsuki's whereabouts. She has an obvious crush on Hinata.
Age (at the time of her disappearance): 13.
Hinata's frail bodied twin sister. Prior to her disappearance, she had almost no social contacts apart from close family and tended to spend all her time with computers.
Devoted member of the hacker team "Criminal".
Acts as the team's system coordinator. Always at loggerheads with Kousuke.

Kousuke is Criminal's only male member and often the butt monkey of other members' jokes. He is the only member without a brain chip and as such tends to handle "brute forcing" and other tasks which require less finesse.
He has a strong sense of justice and acts as the team's "white knight in shining armor".
School doctor of Kyoka Senior High School. Being one of the few people who Hinata willingly associates with, she often acts as his confidant.
She is also Anu, the creator of net MMORPG "Babylon", and former leader of it's administering body "Anunnaki".
A mysterious stranger appearing in unexpected places. A person wrapped in mysteries.
Current head of net RPG "Babylon's" administering body and one of the game's founding members. Also the leader of terrorist organization "Code". Real name is Izumo Tsukasa.
Protagonist of Route D, a robust man.
The lone hacker of urban legends. His name and origin are unknown. Not leaving any traces has lead many to question his very existence.
Seeks vengeance for the death of his loved one, "He" desperately continues fighting against "that organization".
He is voiced by Hagi Michihiko.
Protagonist of Route C, a young woman standing in solitude.
She is searching for someone important.
Compared to Ishtar of Route B, she seems rather cold and aloof.

She is actually Shinozuka Mayumi, the sole member of "Criminal" left alive after Code's attack on eXarch's Tokyo Branch. She decided to assume Ishtar's image and personality after the original's death.
Hinata and Sakuya's classmate. Plays the Net RPG Babylon under the name Chiquitita.
Hinata's and Mutsuki's mother.
She was originally Megumi's Shadow. After the original's death, she became a Null.
Protagonist of Route B, a young woman followed by companions.

The charismatic leader of hacker team "Criminal". She sports a cheerful personality, but is also an able people person, rightfully deserving her position and receiving her comrades' unconditional trust.

She dies at the end of Route B 1.0 at the hands of HE who, by accident, traps her in a hallway filled with toxic gas which kills her. Her consciousness escapes her body and manifests itself into sentient data ('Shadow Null'), alongside the rest of the Criminal gang.
An eXarch employee and former member of the Babylon development team.

segments.text: Hinata and Mutsuki's father.
Sakuya's close friend and classmate.
Inagaki's virtual self in the Net RPG Babylon.
Thanks to the AIO system, he can act on his own while Inagaki is offline.
Ishtar's revered onee-sama. Left on a journey to find Isaiah Nagy's whereabouts. Former member of Anunnaki.
Also, the user of LEM (Una).
An NPC of net RPG Babylon, and also its mascot.
First of the imaginary children.

He hacked and stole from eXarch's bank account to fund his own electric brain operation and his trip to Japan in order to meet with Ereshkigal. Was caught and prosecuted, then locked to eXarch's research facility.

Fed up with prison like life, he uploaded his consciousness to internet, then killed his body by frying his brain augments. Isaiah became the legendary hacker "He" after saving Shinozuka Mayumi from coma.
Uses the handle "Ea".
One of the "Three Founding Gods of Babylon", Ea is also a member of the said Net RPG's current administrative body, "E-Doc".
She is also Ishtar's former friend.
She was killed by Enlil after refusing to cooperate with her.
Kosuke's father. A detective in the cyberforce.
Following {Code}'s attack on {eXarch}, he is the sole survivor of {Code}'s culling of {Criminal} family members.
Andras' younger sister
